mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 6 months signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS declining over the past 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) over the past 12 months signals robust economic growth, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite sustained quarterly GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE rise above 7.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate weakening labor market conditions and potential recession.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05) despite UNRATE exceeding 7.5% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly increases in GDP (GDPC1) and Industrial Production (INDPRO) above their 12-month moving averages signal a robust demand-supply cycle, amplifying corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and INDPRO above 12-month moving averages
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite the interaction of GDPC1 and INDPRO above moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate further easing and reduced policy tightness.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS below 2% in late-cycle expansion.

failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05) despite UNRATE exceeding 7.0% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly declines in Industrial Production (INDPRO) and Residential Construction (HOUST) below their 3-month moving averages signal weakening supply chains and housing demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.

failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05) despite the interaction of INDPRO and HOUST below moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery regime, a sustained monthly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 3% growth triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate sustained economic expansion.
